gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.

gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until it had been read twice.
gaps.explanation: It made sense only after two readings = it didn't make sense until it had been read twice.

gaps.lead: They don't let visitors feed the animals.
gaps.explanation: let somebody do → be allowed to do: are not allowed to feed.

gaps.lead: My father repaired the roof himself.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for it to be done by someone else: had the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: 'I didn't write the graffiti,' the teenager said.
It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
gaps.explanation: should/ought to have + participle expresses past regret/advice.
